content: {"summary":"Many users report that game downloads stall or fail to start, leaving the store in a “Working” state with no progress [#tk_122599] [#tk_2962992]. Several complaints describe the game being deleted or uninstalled after a cancelled update, forcing a full re‑download of large titles [#tk_2138399] [#tk_2961522]. Users also encounter installation stops at high percentages and unresponsive cancel buttons, especially on slower connections [#tk_570273] [#tk_903417]. Finally, some report that purchases trigger automatic installs on the wrong drive or show error messages immediately [#tk_173149] [#tk_891159]."}
